model_annotation: This figure, titled 粘合式"an"结构 (Cohesive "an" Structure), presents two pie charts side by side that together illustrate different aspects of this linguistic structure. The left pie chart contains two slices: a yellow slice labeled 单音形容词+单音名词 (monosyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun) accounting for 229 examples at 69.39%, and a blue slice labeled 双音形容词+单音名词 (disyllabic adjective + monosyllabic noun) accounting for 101 examples at 30.61%. The right pie chart also contains two slices: a large orange slice labeled "的"字只隐不现 (the character "的" is only implicit and does not appear) at 81.66%, and a smaller dark green/teal slice labeled "的"字只现不隐 (the character "的" only appears and is not implicit) at 18.34%. Both charts display percentage labels directly within or adjacent to their respective slices, and the left chart additionally includes raw counts. A legend is provided at the bottom of the figure using numbered color codes (1 for blue, 2 for orange, 3 for yellow/green), though the correspondence between these legend entries and the chart categories is not entirely straightforward. The larger slices dominate their respective charts visually, with the yellow slice occupying roughly two-thirds of the left chart and the orange slice occupying more than four-fifths of the right chart.
